title: Product search with facets

requirements.text: Text queries rank products by relevance with stemming and case/accent folding
Misspelled queries still find the intended products
Facet counts reflect the current query and filters
Category, price-range and availability filters combine correctly; unknown filters are rejected
Results sort by relevance, price or date with stable pagination
Inactive, unpublished or other-tenant products never appear
Query, filters and sort are kept in a shareable URL and parsed defensively

evidence.name: BM25 order and scores on a small known corpus
facet counts over the filtered set
facet counts are grouped counts over the filtered set
keyword, range, date and boolean filters; undeclared filters and attributes are rejected
cursor paging returns every hit once, by relevance and by attribute
storefront and utility sources compile strictly and behave

implementations.notes: filterCatalog excludes inactive products and sorts by price in memory; no facets or relevance

evidence.name: typed URL query state parses leniently and serializes canonically

notes: Typo tolerance needs an external engine such as Typesense or Meilisearch, or pg_trgm in the application.
